findings.issue: The ΔH° > 0, ΔS° < 0 row incorrectly says the process is favored at low temperature. Replace “At low T” with “At no T.”
findings.evidence: Both the source and CED specify that this sign combination is favored at no temperature. For positive absolute temperature, ΔH° is positive and −TΔS° is also positive, so ΔG° > 0.

findings.issue: Make stoichiometric weighting explicit in the formation-free-energy equation: ΔG°ᵣₓₙ = Σ nΔG°f(products) − Σ nΔG°f(reactants).
findings.evidence: The draft matches the source and CED shorthand, so this is not counted as a defect. Standard chemistry requires each standard molar free energy of formation to be multiplied by its balanced-equation coefficient; showing n would prevent students from interpreting the sums as unweighted.
